definitions.explanation: the tendency to forget things, often due to age, distraction, or poor memory

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{物忘|ものわす}れがひどい。
examples.english: My forgetfulness has been terrible lately.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}ると{物忘|ものわす}れが{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: Forgetfulness increases as you get older.

examples.japanese: {物忘|ものわす}れを{防|ふせ}ぐためにメモを{取|と}るようにしている。
examples.english: I try to take notes to prevent forgetfulness.

notes:
FORMATION:
{物|もの} (things) + {忘|わす}れ (forgetting) → forgetting things

RELATED WORDS:
- {ど忘|わす}れ (sudden memory lapse - temporary)
- うっかり{忘|わす}れ (careless forgetfulness)
- {記憶力|きおくりょく} (memory capacity)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {物忘|ものわす}れがひどい (to be very forgetful)
- {物忘|ものわす}れが{激|はげ}しい (to be extremely forgetful)
- {物忘|ものわす}れ{外来|がいらい} (memory clinic)

HEALTH NOTE:
Severe or worsening {物忘|ものわす}れ in older adults may be a sign of dementia and should be evaluated by a doctor.
